entry.name: mc.pitchshift~
entry.description: Use the pitchshift~ object to load a perform pitch-shifting on an input signal.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.description: An optional argument can be used to specify the number of channels of the signal to be processed (default = 1).

attributes.name: pitchshift
attributes.digest: Pitch Shifting Factor
attributes.description: Set the pitchshifting as a factor of the original pitch (i.e. 2.0 = doubling of pitch, .5 = halving of the original pitch, etc.).

attributes.name: pitchshiftcent
attributes.digest: Pitch Shifting in Cents
attributes.description: Set the amount of pitchshift as positive or negative cent values (i.e. 100 = semitone up, -1200 = octave down). Cents may be specified as ints or floats.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: The pitch of signal(s) in the left input(s) will be shifted. A signal in the rightmost inlet defines the shifting as a factor of the original pitch or in cents (whenis enabled).

inlets.description: A signal value can be used to specify pitchshift as a factor of the original pitch (i.e. 2.0 = doubling of pitch, .5 = halving of the original pitch, etc.).
